purpose: Canonical numbering for real trading cases. Raw screenshots/events remain immutable evidence and must not be mistaken for separate numbered trades.
numbering_rule: Increment CASE-N only when a distinct actual position/thesis begins after the prior actual position is closed or explicitly reset. News events, screenshots, CVD/OI observations, audits and scenario branches are evidence within a case, not new numbered cases.

cases.note: CASE-002 includes the full Sep 8-11 lead-in, including Sep 9 divergences, Sep 10 capitulation/failed-reclaim research, Sep 11 CPI and the eventual long. It does not begin at CPI.

next_case_gate: Do not create CASE-003 until CASE-002 is explicitly confirmed closed/reset by the owner.
